title: [Master]-Reserved quantities do not match the expected quantities after planning - regression due to correction
summary: Fixes a regression, caused by an earlier correction, where reserved quantities did not match the expected quantities after planning. The change is in the Mfg. Invt. Profile Offsetting codeunit and comes with new tests.
key_points: Fixes reserved quantities not matching expected quantities after planning
Regression was introduced by an earlier correction
Change is in codeunit Mfg. Invt. Profile Offsetting
Adds tests in SCM Production Orders II
